content.title: Sewer Line Replacements
content.summary: The city will undertake sewer line replacement projects in 2026 at three locations: W. 78th Place and Reed St., W. 56th Ave. and Marshall St., and W. 62nd Ave. and Webster St. These projects, funded by wastewater rates, aim to maintain safe and reliable wastewater services, with construction expected to begin in June and continue through August, involving road closures and potential water shut-offs. Residents will be notified in advance of any disruptions, and full repaving is not included in the project scope.
content.body:
## Overview

These projects will replace aging sewer lines to continue to maintain safe, reliable wastewater services. Areas scheduled for work in 2026:

1. W. 78th Place and Reed St.
2. W. 56th Ave. and Marshall St.
3. W. 62nd Ave. and Webster St.

The wastewater rates you pay directly fund these projects and the repair and replacement of aging utility infrastructure in Arvada to ensure we can continue to provide safe, reliable services. Learn more about the City’s approach to long range planning and funding for utility improvements on the [Utilities Transparency webpage](/661).

## Jay Court

Final paving is underway on Jay Court and expected to be complete by the end of May. This will complete the project.

### Project area

- Jay Court from W 75th Ave to cul-de-sac
- W 74th Circle to slightly west of Jay Ct on W 74th Pl

## W. 78th Place & Reed St.

This project will take place along W. 78th Place from Reed to Saulsbury streets.![map of construction zone on 78th Place from Reed to Saulsbury](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=7546)

### Timeline

Construction is expected to take**1 to 2 months, beginning in early June, as soon as June 8**. Timelines are construction and weather permitting and subject to change.

### What to expect

- Working hours 7 am - 7 pm
- Road closures with local access only
  - Follow detour signage on site
- Additional construction noise and traffic
- Water shut-offs may be necessary
  - Residents will be notified 48 hours in advance
- Residents may occasionally be asked to limit water and sewer use during working hours
- Unpleasant odors may be present at times
- Full repaving is not within the scope of this project area

## W. 56th Ave. & Marshall St.

This project will include both water and sewer line replacement along Marshall St near W 56th Avenue.![construction map showing work along Marshall St. and 56th Avenue](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=7548)

### Timeline

Construction is expected to take **1 to 2 months, beginning in late June or early July**. Timelines are construction and weather permitting and subject to change.

### What to expect

- Working hours 7 am - 7 pm
- Full and single lane road closures
  - Follow detour signage on site
- Additional construction noise and traffic
- Water shut-offs may be necessary
  - Residents and businesses will be notified 48 hours in advance
- Tenants may occasionally be asked to limit water and sewer use during working hours
- Unpleasant odors may be present at times
- Full repaving is not within the scope of this project area

## W. 62nd Ave. & Webster St.

This project will take place along W. 62nd Avenue between Wadsworth Bypass and Olde Wadsworth Blvd.![map of construction zone from Wadsworth to Olde Wadsworth on 62nd Avenue](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=7547)

### Timeline

Construction is expected to take **2 to 3 weeks, beginning in mid to late August.**Timelines are construction and weather permitting and subject to change.

### What to expect

- Working hours 7 am - 7 pm
- Full closure of 62nd Ave. from Wadsworth Blvd. to Olde Wadsworth
  - Local access only
  - Follow detour signage on site
- Additional construction noise and traffic
- Water shut-offs may be necessary
  - Residents will be notified 48 hours in advance
- Tenants may occasionally be asked to limit water and sewer use during working hours
- Unpleasant odors may be present at times
- Full repaving is not within the scope of this project

## Contact Us

Please submit a ticket through [Ask Arvada](https://seeclickfix.com/web_portal/m96AzqbgQ9RW9z5CcqFqEwP8/issues/map) and a team member will be in touch.

For accessibility needs, please contact the project team through[Ask Arvada](/898) to coordinate accommodations in the work zone.
